newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST-Modelo Q3 volumes seen strong.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Modelo Q3 volumes seen strong.

text.p: Mexico's beer producer Grupo Modelo SA is seen reporting healthy third quarter profits due to strong volume increases, analysts said.

"Modelo's (stock price has) been up quite a bit. They've had quite a run-up in anticipation of this. I don't expect to see any unexpected results in this report," said Jose Yordan, an analyst with CS First Boston.
Modelo is expected to report on Monday, and analysts are seen focusing closely on the sales volume growth number.

Meeting a 30 percent export growth figure will depend a lot on distribution in the United States, analysts said.
One dark cloud, however, is that operating expenses are going to increase due to higher advertising costs. "This is going to make operating income fall by about 10 percent," the analyst said.
Earlier this month, Interacciones upgraded Modelo to long-term buy from hold.
Analyst Isabel Rueda said that in the first quarter of 1997, Modelo will start operations on the first phase of its new plant in Zacatecas.
